This depends on what you are looking for but here's some ones I know of Combat Sims War Thunder, Free to Play MMO with varying levels of difficulty depending on how hard you want it to be (by joining 3 different game modes) ranging from arcade to simulator, the flight dynamics are plausible for the most part and it is pretty fun. Digital Combat Simulator, Technically a free game (though you only get one aircraft to start with) that is highly realistic and very difficult to get into to.

Civil Flight Sims X-Plane, Engineering software that doubles as a hardcore civil flight simulator, great flight dynamics for obvious reasons and virtual cockpits but struggles in the areas of flight planning and ATC. It also supports multi-monitors/multi-computer setups better imo. Finally the UI is also lacking for the most part

FSX The second to last flight simulator from Microsoft, flight dynamics are about the same as X-plane for the most part, though that's up for Debate. It also has far superior ATC and flight planning tools with a much better UI to navigate through as well. Doesn't really support multi-monitor/computer setups out of the box.

Trans is a little different situation, because it isn't just feelings for one gender or the other - it's dissatisfaction with your own body. I believe Gender Dysphoria is the correct term for it.
